blocks.content: The Ministry of Railways approved reforms to the Model Concession Agreement for Container Train Operators on 6 August 2026. The revised framework introduces a single All India Licence for container train operations across the national railway network.

items: The Model Concession Agreement is a standard contractual framework used for private participation in infrastructure projects.
Container Train Operators handle containerised freight movement on the Indian Railways network.
